verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury exposes FinancialAccount objects through the API, and every fund movement creates a Transaction ledger object meant for building activity feeds and reconciliation. ReceivedDebit objects and v2 transaction-created events give programmatic visibility into money movement, and docs are agent-readable via llms.txt and .md pages. Stripe also ships an official MCP server, but the evidence does not show it covering Treasury data. missing for 10: explicit pending/in-flight activity status, an API for documents or statements, evidence that the MCP server exposes Treasury accounts and transactions, independent hands-on corroboration of agent read access.
